case_study_packaging.headline: Residential home-services platform unlocks $927K in annual savings and 2.2x ROI through Treya-led strategic sourcing
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Cascade Residential Services, a fast-growing multi-brand HVAC, plumbing and electrical provider backed by Trive Capital and LP First Capital, was purchasing everything from HVAC equipment to uniforms through fragmented, local agreements. The decentralized model limited purchasing leverage, obscured true spend, and left millions of dollars on the table just as the sponsors were pushing for rapid EBITDA expansion. Cascade needed a partner to aggregate spend, run competitive events, and stand up a scalable procurement process without burdening its lean management team.
case_study_packaging.client_problem_anonymized: A fast-growing multi-brand residential home-services platform was purchasing everything from HVAC equipment to uniforms through fragmented, local agreements. The decentralized model limited purchasing leverage, obscured true spend, and left millions of dollars on the table just as the private equity ownership group focused on operational efficiency and margin improvement. The platform needed a partner to aggregate spend, run competitive events, and stand up a scalable procurement process without burdening its lean management team.
approach_summary: Consolidated AP data from 13 brands to build a $33M baseline and identify $26.5M in addressable spend across nine direct and indirect categories.
Negotiated national pricebooks and enhanced rebate programs with Carrier, Lennox and Rheem covering $7.3M in HVAC equipment, driving over $800K in annual rebates and pricing improvements.
Executed a multi-vendor RFP for HVACR & plumbing supplies and issued standardized MOUs that lock in pricing, early-pay discounts and inventory service levels.
Leveraged a Rampart GPO partnership to shift uniform rentals to Unifirst, cutting costs by 43% while standardizing service terms across all locations.
Secured an 8% discounted program with Interplay Learning for technician training and implemented enterprise-wide rebate tracking and price-increase governance to sustain savings.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya delivered $927,045 in verified annual run-rate savings—meeting the top half of the original $0.87–$1.69 M estimate and generating a 2.2x return on the $425K fixed project fee. Beyond the hard dollars, the engagement put in place national pricebooks, rebate tracking, and supplier governance that give Cascade clear visibility and control over more than $10M in critical equipment and supplies spend, setting the foundation for future add-on acquisitions.
where_we_were_unique: Delivered first rebate checks within 120 days of kickoff by prioritizing quick-win OEM agreements.
Deep HVAC industry knowledge and manufacturer relationships enabled access to top-tier national programs typically reserved for much larger contractors.
Hands-on, data-driven approach relieved the client’s limited procurement staff, with Treya managing supplier outreach, analytics and contract drafting.
Exceeded the client’s 2x ROI requirement and did so while navigating incumbent sensitivities and complex multi-brand stakeholder dynamics.
